n6c6447ebb9.headline: Baku Steel Company increased exports to the USA and Europe in 2025
n6c6447ebb9.summary: Baku Steel Company, the leading metallurgical enterprise in the South Caucasus, increased its exports to the United States and Europe in 2025. The company continues to strengthen its international market position.
n6c6447ebb9.why: Baku Steel is a major steel producer in Azerbaijan. Its export growth reflects Azerbaijan's non-energy trade and industrial output.

na32d367acb.headline: Fraud blamed for Tongaat Hulett collapse
na32d367acb.summary: Businessman Robert Gumede says Tongaat Hulett's downfall stems from massive fraud, not broad-based black economic empowerment rules. The company has faced years of financial turmoil.
na32d367acb.why: Tongaat Hulett is a South African sugar and property company whose collapse affected farmers, employees and creditors. Its case is a major test of corporate governance in South Africa.

nf8ed7285ce.headline: UK economy flatlines unexpectedly in January
nf8ed7285ce.summary: The Office for National Statistics reported zero growth in UK gross domestic product in January. The result was described as unexpected.
nf8ed7285ce.why: GDP growth is the broadest measure of economic output and shapes Bank of England rate expectations, gilt yields and sterling.
nf8ed7285ce.why_moved: The ONS reported zero GDP growth in January, which the article describes as unexpected, weakening the outlook for UK activity.

naca1576359.headline: Inflation in Azerbaijan remains unchanged
naca1576359.summary: Inflation in Azerbaijan remained unchanged in February 2026, according to Apa.az. The report notes consumer prices were reported for the month.
naca1576359.why: Consumer price inflation shapes central bank policy and household purchasing power in the economy.

n5af60809b9.headline: Pak faces severe medicine shortage amid import disruptions, just 45 days’ stock left
n5af60809b9.summary: Pakistan faces a serious shortage of essential medicines as the Middle East conflict disrupts imports of pharmaceutical raw materials, with just 45 days of stock left, a report said.
n5af60809b9.why: Pakistan relies heavily on imported pharmaceutical inputs, so supply disruptions affect healthcare costs and the broader economy.

n69dd3184eb.headline: Rs 2,000 crore daily loss! OMCs take Rs 20 per litre hit on petrol, Rs 45 on diesel - BusinessToday
n69dd3184eb.summary: Indian oil marketing companies are reportedly losing Rs 20 per litre on petrol and Rs 45 on diesel, with Rs 2,000 crore in daily losses. Higher tanker freight and insurance costs were cited.
n69dd3184eb.why: Oil marketing companies such as IOC and BPCL sell retail fuel in India, so they absorb losses when pump prices lag crude costs.

n84ece865a2.headline: Servos under the pump over quickfire fuel price hikes
n84ece865a2.summary: Petrol and diesel prices were hiked dramatically almost straight after war broke out in the Middle East, drawing criticism of service station operators.
n84ece865a2.why: Retail fuel prices in Australia track global crude and refined product costs, and sharp increases draw regulatory and political attention.

n7370e5d68e.headline: Trump says US will hit Iran ‘very hard over the next week’ after easing sanctions on Russian oil
n7370e5d68e.summary: Oil prices rose despite a US sanctions waiver on Russian oil, with Brent crude at US$99.50, as Trump said the US would hit Iran very hard over the next week.
n7370e5d68e.why: Sanctions on Russian crude shape global oil supply, and Brent is the main international benchmark for crude prices.
n7370e5d68e.why_moved: Prices rose despite the US waiver on Russian oil sanctions, as renewed threats against Iran kept supply concerns elevated.

n18c5793f22.headline: Qantas customers claim $105m compo over COVID credits
n18c5793f22.summary: Qantas has settled a claim over COVID-era credits, and a $105 million pot could be shared among hundreds of thousands of customers. The settlement is reported by the carrier's customers' lawyers.
n18c5793f22.why: Qantas is Australia's largest airline and flag carrier, and its customer obligations affect its financial results.

nf5d7573112.headline: Why Kerosene & Coal Are Returning In India, West Asia Tensions Disrupt Oil And Gas Flow Through Strait Of Hormuz | Explained
nf5d7573112.summary: India has temporarily permitted kerosene, coal and alternate fuels as West Asia conflict disrupts energy flows through the Strait of Hormuz. Emergency LPG measures prioritise households.
nf5d7573112.why: LPG and crude imports are critical to India's energy supply, and disruptions affect household costs and inflation.

nf1db7d6762.headline: US Sanctions Ring Enabling North Korea IT Worker Fraud
nf1db7d6762.summary: The US Treasury sanctioned six individuals and two entities allegedly tied to a North Korean IT worker fraud ring. Assets were frozen and 21 crypto addresses were blacklisted.
nf1db7d6762.why: US sanctions restrict dealings with blacklisted persons and entities, and crypto address blacklisting affects exchanges and wallet services that screen transactions.

n78b0d82254.headline: Israel-Iran War Hits Rural Hotel Industry In Nashik, Hotels Shut Due To LPG Shortage; Some Turn To Electric And Wood Stoves
n78b0d82254.summary: At least 8 to 10 hotels in Nashik district have shut due to an LPG shortage linked to the Israel-Iran war. Some owners are switching to electric stoves, induction cooktops and wood-fired stoves.
n78b0d82254.why: LPG is a major cooking fuel in India, and supply disruptions affect hospitality businesses and household costs.

na1ccbad320.headline: Poland’s Tusk defies president’s veto over €43.7bn EU defence loan
na1ccbad320.summary: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said he would access €43.7 billion in EU defence funds, defying President Karol Nawrocki's veto. Tusk argued the decision goes against Poland's sovereignty.
na1ccbad320.why: EU defence loans fund member-state military spending and affect public borrowing, defence contractors and the government's budget plans.

n1903707fa8.headline: ASEAN ministers urge halt to Middle East war as crisis rattles energy and trade
n1903707fa8.summary: ASEAN foreign and economic ministers called for an immediate halt to the Middle East war. They said surging oil prices and disrupted trade are already hitting Southeast Asia's economies.
n1903707fa8.why: ASEAN is the Southeast Asian bloc whose economies depend heavily on imported energy and open trade routes.

nfb0e532d3f.headline: Metroglass turnaround delayed to later this year as weak building market hits revenue
nfb0e532d3f.summary: Metroglass has delayed its turnaround to later this year as a weak building market hit revenue, though a $35 million debt cut and new bank deals have strengthened the balance sheet.
nfb0e532d3f.why: Metroglass is an Australian maker of glass and window products for the building sector, so its results reflect construction activity.

n93192d25ea.headline: NSE unlisted share hold firm as IPO preps intensify; valuations near Rs 5 lakh crore - BusinessToday
n93192d25ea.summary: NSE unlisted shares have held their ground as the exchange appointed 20 merchant banks and 8 law firms to support its IPO, with valuations near Rs 5 lakh crore.
n93192d25ea.why: The National Stock Exchange of India is one of the largest exchanges globally, so its planned listing is a major event for Indian capital markets.

n34ae4918ea.headline: 'No Need To Panic': India Has Adequate Fuel Stocks, Assures Petroleum Ministry Amid Shortage Fears
n34ae4918ea.summary: India's Petroleum Ministry said petrol and diesel stocks are adequate and refineries are operating at full capacity. LPG production has risen 30%, and officials urged people not to panic-buy.
n34ae4918ea.why: India imports most of its crude and LPG, so supply disruptions in the Gulf directly affect the country's fuel security and consumer prices.

nd6c230a2c2.headline: Trump threatens Iran after new attacks
nd6c230a2c2.summary: Trump issued a new threat against Iran following drone attacks on Gulf states and Israel. The article describes the conflict as escalating.
nd6c230a2c2.why: US policy toward Iran shapes sanctions, oil supply risk and the security outlook for Gulf producers.

nba6decdfcc.headline: How much each state will get from the GST carve-up
nba6decdfcc.summary: Every Australian state and territory will receive more GST revenue in 2026/27. Some states are relatively worse off under the new distribution.
nba6decdfcc.why: GST revenue allocation determines how much funding each Australian state receives for budgets and public services.

n275b45b7a8.headline: Trump threatens Iran following new wave of attacks on Gulf states and Israel
n275b45b7a8.summary: Iran launched multiple new attacks on Gulf states and Israel, prompting threats from President Trump, according to Associated Press reporting.
n275b45b7a8.why: Attacks and threats across the Gulf region affect oil supply routes and risk premiums, which matter for energy markets and global equities.
n275b45b7a8.why_moved: Renewed attacks on Gulf states and Israel and threats of retaliation raise fears of wider conflict and disruption to Middle East energy supply.

n44f40d7da3.headline: "Iran War Could Spark The Next Global Food Crisis"
n44f40d7da3.summary: The Iran conflict is driving up energy and fertilizer costs, raising alarms over a return of food inflation. Farmers are bracing for resource shortages that could reduce harvests.
n44f40d7da3.why: Fertilizer and energy are major inputs for agriculture, so their costs feed directly into food prices and crop yields.

nf2aba59b60.headline: PSX rangebound as oil surge, IMF delay dampen sentiment
nf2aba59b60.summary: The KSE-100 index settled at 153,866.16, down 0.36%, after hitting an intraday low of 152,780.79. Stocks remained rangebound amid the oil surge and IMF delay.
nf2aba59b60.why: The KSE-100 is the benchmark index of the largest listed companies on the Pakistan Stock Exchange.

n66cb0bb756.headline: iPhone Fold's pricing, RAM, and storage details tipped
n66cb0bb756.summary: New details on the pricing, RAM and storage of Apple's foldable iPhone have reportedly leaked. The device is said to start at under $2,000.
n66cb0bb756.why: Apple is one of the largest consumer technology companies, and new premium device launches influence its revenue and product cycle.

nca06df8484.headline: 'Broken and unfair': states urge change to GST carve-up
nca06df8484.summary: States say the contentious GST carve-up is broken and unfair. The cost to Australian taxpayers will rise by another $6.6 billion in 2026/27.
nca06df8484.why: The GST revenue distribution between Australian states determines how federal goods and services tax income is shared. It shapes state budgets and public spending.

n6c6cfa711f.headline: Iran's new leader 'wounded, likely disfigured', US says
n6c6cfa711f.summary: US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth said Iran's new supreme leader is wounded and likely disfigured.
n6c6cfa711f.why: Leadership changes in Iran shape the direction of its foreign and nuclear policy, which drives geopolitical risk premiums in oil and regional markets.

na31d20ad32.headline: ASEAN FMs discuss implications of Middle East conflict
na31d20ad32.summary: ASEAN foreign ministers in Manila called for an immediate cessation of hostilities in the Middle East and resolution of differences through diplomacy.
na31d20ad32.why: ASEAN is a regional bloc of ten Southeast Asian states, and its positions matter for trade and energy security in a region dependent on Middle East oil.

nbd1d2d735a.headline: ASEAN calls for halt to Middle East war as oil shock hits region
nbd1d2d735a.summary: ASEAN foreign and economic ministers called on Friday for an immediate halt to the Middle East war, as the oil shock hits the region.
nbd1d2d735a.why: ASEAN is a bloc of Southeast Asian economies that rely heavily on imported energy, so oil shocks affect their growth and inflation.

ne5dd1a568c.headline: Rising Middle East tensions pose inflation risk for Pakistan, warns study
ne5dd1a568c.summary: A study by PIDE researcher Abida Naurin warned that Middle East tensions could push global oil prices sharply higher, creating significant inflation risks for Pakistan.
ne5dd1a568c.why: Pakistan is a large oil importer, so higher crude prices widen its trade deficit and feed into domestic inflation.

nefb3eec450.headline: Companies face rising pressure from fuel prices
nefb3eec450.summary: Higher fuel prices tied to Middle East tensions are adding pressure on businesses across Vietnam, with transport operators facing sharply higher operating costs.
nefb3eec450.why: Fuel is a major input cost for logistics and transport, so sustained price rises compress margins across consumer and industrial sectors.

n4b5e058db3.headline: Donald Trump threatens Iran after new wave of attacks on Gulf states and Israel
n4b5e058db3.summary: US President Donald Trump threatened Iran after a new wave of attacks on Gulf states and Israel. The threat followed the first public statements from Iran's new leader.
n4b5e058db3.why: US policy toward Iran shapes regional security, oil supply expectations and risk sentiment across global markets.

n61cc856117.headline: US Hits Iran With Intense Strikes As Iranian Air Campaign Drives Oil Prices Higher
n61cc856117.summary: Oil prices rose back above $100 a barrel as American and Israeli strikes hit Iran and Iran attacked Persian Gulf shipping and energy infrastructure. No end to the war was in sight.
n61cc856117.why: Crude oil is the benchmark energy commodity, and Gulf supply disruptions feed directly into fuel costs, inflation and transport and energy company earnings.
n61cc856117.why_moved: Attacks on Gulf shipping and energy facilities threaten supply, pushing crude prices above $100 a barrel.

n9a969ddfac.headline: Honda cancels three EVs globally: India Plans, Concept 0 alpha unchanged
n9a969ddfac.summary: Honda Motor has cancelled development and launch of three electric vehicles planned for production in North America. The Concept 0 alpha project is unchanged.
n9a969ddfac.why: Honda is a major Japanese automaker, and its EV strategy affects its capital spending and competitiveness in electric vehicles.

impacts.name: Honda Motor
impacts.why: Cancelling planned EV programs changes the company's electric vehicle product pipeline.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n92a23dd385.headline: Trump news at a glance: president shrugs off highest gas prices in years
n92a23dd385.summary: Trump says the US makes a lot of money when oil prices rise, while rising fuel costs could become a political liability, the Guardian reports.
n92a23dd385.why: US gasoline prices influence consumer spending, inflation expectations and political sentiment ahead of elections.

nead603b0ce.headline: Dalal Street bleeds: Sensex sinks 900 points at open, Nifty below 23,400 | Indiablooms - First Portal on Digital News Management
nead603b0ce.summary: Indian markets plunged in early trade, with the Sensex dropping more than 900 points and the Nifty slipping below 23,400.
nead603b0ce.why: The BSE Sensex and NSE Nifty are the main benchmark indexes of Indian equities, tracking the country's largest listed companies.
nead603b0ce.why_moved: Markets opened sharply lower amid the broader Middle East conflict and global risk aversion, according to the report.

nca808e03d7.headline: Bangladesh to draft 2025–26 budget amid global conflict risks, focus on inflation and social protection
nca808e03d7.summary: Bangladesh will frame its 2025–26 national budget amid the global war environment, with a focus on inflation and social protection.
nca808e03d7.why: The national budget sets government spending and revenue plans that shape inflation, growth and fiscal stability.

n0adacd4293.headline: US hits Iran's Kharg Island as oil prices surge
n0adacd4293.summary: US and Israeli strikes hit Iran's Kharg Island as oil prices surged. American and Israeli attacks on Iran continue amid the ongoing war.
n0adacd4293.why: Kharg Island is Iran's main crude export terminal, so attacks there directly affect global oil flows.
n0adacd4293.why_moved: Strikes on Kharg Island amid the Iran war raised fears of supply disruption, and oil prices surged.

n1783dcde29.headline: Trump says US will hit Iran ‘very hard’ for another week
n1783dcde29.summary: Trump said the US will hit Iran very hard for another week. He had earlier called the war complete and promised to guarantee the safety of vessels in the Strait of Hormuz.
n1783dcde29.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of global seaborne oil, so shipping security there directly affects energy markets.
n1783dcde29.why_moved: Announced continuation of strikes on Iran and the Strait of Hormuz shipping situation add to supply-risk concerns for oil.

nc387a33ab1.headline: World Bank initiative aims to boost digital economy in three African countries
nc387a33ab1.summary: The World Bank approved a regional initiative focused on digital infrastructure to create jobs and boost the digital economy in Benin, Liberia, and Sierra Leone.
nc387a33ab1.why: Digital infrastructure investments are vital for economic growth and job creation in developing African economies.

n6c663e2517.headline: 530 UK mortgage deals disappear in a week as hopes
n6c663e2517.summary: The UK mortgage market saw 530 deals disappear in one week, with some average mortgage rates breaking through the 5% mark.
n6c663e2517.why: Rising mortgage rates and fewer deals indicate tightening credit conditions in the UK housing market, affecting consumer borrowing and real estate investment.
n6c663e2517.why_moved: Mortgage rates surpassing 5% reduce affordability and lender willingness, causing a sharp drop in available mortgage deals.

n5d5bd409f2.headline: Panama Canal could gain as Mideast conflict drives fuel costs higher
n5d5bd409f2.summary: Panama Canal Administrator Ricaurte Vásquez stated that the Middle East conflict and higher fuel prices could ultimately benefit the canal's operations.
n5d5bd409f2.why: The Panama Canal is a critical global shipping route; shifts in fuel costs and geopolitical tensions can affect trade volumes and revenues.
